products.name: Oreo Original Chocolate Sandwich Cookies
products.summary: Oreo has a complete source-backed package journey across the vintage slots, but the recipe journey is still locked because no comparable ingredient statement has been manually verified.
products.story_thesis: The visible story is the proof chase: package and label leads exist, but the original-to-current ingredient comparison cannot publish until readable panels become reviewed text.
products.claim_boundary: 1912 original ingredient label not verified. Do not imply a verified original recipe or a full original-to-current formulation diff.
products.next_unlock: Start with label-visible current and 2010s records, transcribe against source images/pages, then attach reviewer attribution before comparing ingredients.

photo_quality_summary.headline: Photo evidence now strengthens the package map, not the ingredient claims.
photo_quality_summary.can_prove: Era/package presence, source owner, some date-basis clues, and candidate SKU/package context.
photo_quality_summary.cannot_prove: Ingredient substitutions, oil/sweetener changes, original 1912 recipe, or package weight normalization without readable reviewed panels.
photo_quality_summary.highest_value_next: Prioritize back-panel or full-package photos for 1990s, 2000s, and 1950s-1960s objects; current and 2010s label-text candidates can move into manual verification first.

facets.label: Fat/Oil System
facets.detail: High-interest story lane. Current and 2010s label-text candidates can seed review, but no oil-system change can be asserted until older package photos yield readable ingredient panels.
facets.photo_unlock: Back-panel photos or verified transcriptions for 1990s, 2000s, and 1950s-1960s packages.

facets.label: Sweeteners
facets.detail: Ingredient text is required before sugar/HFCS/invert-sugar comparisons can be made. EWG/current records provide candidates, not timeline proof.
facets.photo_unlock: Comparable ingredient panels across at least two eras, preferably current plus 2010s plus one pre-2000 package.

facets.label: Flour/Grain
facets.detail: Needs parsed ingredient statements to compare enriched flour and subingredients. Package fronts do not prove nested flour terms.
facets.photo_unlock: Readable ingredient statement photos or package-derived text with reviewer correction.

facets.label: Cocoa/Chocolate
facets.detail: Cocoa/chocolate terms must come from reviewed labels, not product names or product photos.
facets.photo_unlock: Full ingredient panel for each compared package/SKU.

facets.label: Package Weight
facets.detail: Source titles expose current 14.3 oz and 13.29 oz hints, while vintage package photos can improve format context. Normalized analysis still waits for captured net weight and price links.
facets.photo_unlock: Back/front package photos with net weight visible, plus price observation links.

facets.label: Evidence Quality
facets.detail: This is the current publishable story: photo sources improve the package map while blocked ingredient lanes remain explicit.
facets.photo_unlock: Promote each source through visible package, readable panel, OCR/manual correction, and reviewer verification.
